title: Soft rainforest bird phrase
role: Separate original distant low forest dove answer, short warm hollow phrase
prompt: TrackType: SFX, A solitary distant rainforest dove utters one small warm low pitched breathy hoo-hooo phrase, a husky hollow coo in the lower middle register around 400 Hz. Soft rounded muted wooden bird voice, slower than a chirp, very brief and quiet, gently falling away into silence between trees. Not a whistle or sharp bright bird, no high pitched chirping, not rhythmic or busy. No rain, wind, background chorus, frogs, human voice, music or instruments. Length: 5 seconds.

processing: Official pipeline output preserved as stereo44100Hz32-bit float WAV without clipping or normalization. No reverb, compression, mixing or post-effects added. Browser copy normalized separately.
listeningReview: Technical validity checked. Perceptual prompt adherence requires audition.
